notesForAI:
PIGMENT vs FILL
• Bright accents = pigments on keywords/icons OR fill of the single crown card
• Pastels = card-background fills only; never text or icon color
• All icons and body text = graphite

PIGMENT SYNTAX RULE
• Never embed color markup inside rendered text
• Describe pigmentation as a separate instruction above the text block
• Rendered text must be clean — no brackets, no hex codes, no markup characters
• Applies to: title accents, etymology highlights, pull-quote keywords

TYPOGRAPHY
• Title: UPPERCASE extra-bold, 2 lines max
• Subtitle: sentence case, text gray
• Card title plates: UPPERCASE bold white on graphite, corner radius 10px, padding 8px×16px, identical font size across all detail cards
• Body text: sentence case graphite
• Sub-points: sentence case bold graphite
• Etymology: italic
• Meta pill: UPPERCASE light-gray on dark slate, letter-spacing +0.05em

ICONS
• Outline, 2px stroke, graphite
• Each icon alone on its own row, above its title plate — never beside it
